subject: Promo Voucher Request — Non-Prod Surge for Weekend Soak
messages:
From: Jake Morales <jake@fastretail.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@fastretail.com
Date: 2027-09-23T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Weekend soak — need temporary credits/voucher for non-prod surge

Hi Kimberly,

Quick ask — we’re lining up a weekend soak to validate throughput and tail-latency at scale for the holiday SKU rush. The test run will be non-prod but will hit the same concurrency patterns as production (simulated traffic, long tail of short prompts). Our engineers estimate ~48 hours of steady soak with spikes up to 250 RPS and ~1.8M tokens total.

Can Redwood provision a promo voucher or temporary credit uplift for the weekend of Sep 25–26 so we don’t throttle while we validate autoscaling and cache hit behaviors? We’re not requesting production capacity — just enough sandbox headroom to finish the soak and log performance traces.

Attachments: test-plan-v2.docx (plan), perf-matrix.csv (expected profiles)

Thanks,
Jake
Jake Morales
SRE Manager, FastRetail
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Jake Morales <jake@fastretail.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ops@fastretail.com, procure@fastretail.com
Date: 2027-09-23T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend soak — need temporary credits/voucher for non-prod surge

Jake — thanks for the clear scope. That sounds reasonable and something we can often support with a short promo voucher for non-prod runs. A couple quick clarifying points before I submit a voucher request to credits team:

- Can you confirm the expected token budget ceiling (you mentioned ~1.8M but want the safety multiplier you prefer)
- Will traces/logs be uploaded to your FastRetail project (yes/no) — we need to confirm retention settings for non-prod
- Do you need a single voucher code or multiple (team members running parallel suites)?

If you want to target safety, provision a 1.5x buffer on tokens (so request ~2.7M) and include a short MOP (runbook) for us to reference. I’ll loop in Stephanie for approvals and get back with a voucher code and TTL.

I’m copying Marissa to flag this as a near-term POC milestone; we’ll aim to get an answer inside the day so you can schedule the soak.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — developer-first LLM inference
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Jake Morales <jake@fastretail.com>, ops@fastretail.com
Date: 2027-09-23T14:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekend soak — need temporary credits/voucher for non-prod surge

Thanks Kim & Jake — happy to help. Per our promo policy for trials and POCs, we can issue a one-time non-prod voucher with the following guardrails:

- Voucher value: equivalent to 2.5M tokens (covers the 1.8M estimate + buffer); expires 2027-09-28T00:00:00-07:00
- Scope: non-production project only; no cross-region promotion; logs/traces allowed but retention limited to 30 days unless contracted
- Rate limiting: we’ll temporarily lift default trial concurrency caps up to 300 RPS for the voucher window.
- Activation: engineering must confirm the project id and shared MOP reference.

I’ve attached the voucher stub (FR-voucher-0923.pdf) and a mutual action plan template — please fill the MA plan and return. We’ll provision the voucher once procure confirms the awareness/acceptance of trial terms.

Note for Marissa: approving the voucher here is within promo thresholds; if they request a TTL longer than 72 hours or production elevation we’ll route to Sales Ops.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Growth Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment: FR-voucher-0923.pdf (voucher code and value), mutual-action-plan-FastRetail.xlsx
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: Jake Morales <jake@fastretail.com>, procure@fastretail.com
Date: 2027-09-24T17:33:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Promo Voucher Request — Non-Prod Surge for Weekend Soak

Looping final approval. Kimberly — please confirm you’ve received the voucher PDF and that FastRetail’s procurement team has been looped for acceptance. Tagging the ticket in HubSpot for traceability (link below).

Operational notes:
- If the soak surfaces sustained high KV-cache churn, ops should run the quantization/kv cache diagnostics and share the traces before voucher expiry.
- We’ll mark this voucher as promotional credit tied to deal FR-2027-313; if they convert to Dedicated within 30 days we can discuss applying a similar uplift to an initial reservation.

Kim — once procure confirms, advise Jake they can start their run. I’ll close the internal approval loop.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Related hubspot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/FR-2027-313
